Please use the information provided by the user about architectural layer or coding standard to generate clear and concise agent instructions in the docs/ directory in markdown format. Use the name provided by the user as the filename for the generated instructions. If no name is provided, then use a filename appropriate to the content. If no user input is provided, please prompt the user for the necessary information before generating the instructions.
